description: This PHP source file defines the AWS ComputeOptimizerClient class, which is a client for interacting with the AWS Compute Optimizer service. It includes method annotations for various operations like exporting recommendations, getting recommendations, and updating enrollment status.

classes.name: ComputeOptimizerClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with the AWS Compute Optimizer service, providing methods for exporting, retrieving, and updating recommendations and configurations.

methods.name: deleteRecommendationPreferences
methods.description: Deletes recommendation preferences in AWS Compute Optimizer.

methods.name: exportAutoScalingGroupRecommendations
methods.description: Exports recommendations for Auto Scaling Groups.

methods.name: getAutoScalingGroupRecommendations
methods.description: Retrieves recommendations for Auto Scaling Groups.

methods.name: getEC2RecommendationProjectedMetrics
methods.description: Retrieves projected metrics for EC2 recommendations.

methods.name: getECSServiceRecommendationProjectedMetrics
methods.description: Retrieves projected metrics for ECS service recommendations.

methods.name: getEnrollmentStatus
methods.description: Gets the enrollment status for AWS Compute Optimizer.

methods.name: getEnrollmentStatusesForOrganization
methods.description: Gets enrollment statuses for the organization.

methods.name: getRDSDatabaseRecommendationProjectedMetrics
methods.description: Gets projected metrics for RDS database recommendations.

methods.name: updateEnrollmentStatus
methods.description: Updates the enrollment status for AWS Compute Optimizer.
